name: app-69440a7838988191b4d33fd95c83b1ae
description: BMWUSA makes shopping for your next BMW simple. Browse local inventory, configure the features you care about, view current offers, and schedule a test drive.

interface.longDescription: BMWUSA makes shopping for your next BMW simple. Browse local inventory, configure the features you care about, view current offers, and schedule a test drive.
defaultPrompt: I want to build my own 330i Sedan in blue and 18" wheels.
Are there any incentives for the i7?

positive.expected_behavior: Triggers search_bmw_inventory tool and displays a UI with a list of BMW M5 vehicles available near ZIP code 10019 (NYC)

positive.prompt: Are there any incentives for the i4?
positive.expected_behavior: Triggers special-offers tool and displays a UI showing current incentives and special offers for the BMW i4

positive.prompt: I want to build my own 330i sedan with Arctic Race Blue, can you help me with it?
positive.expected_behavior: Triggers search-models and/or get-available-options and/or start-configuration tools and displays a configuration UI showing the BMW 330i sedan with the requested custom paint

positive.description: Viewing color options for the 430i Coupe
positive.prompt: What color options does the 430i Coupe come in?
positive.expected_behavior: Triggers search-models and/or get-available-options tools and displays a list of available color options for the BMW 430i Coupe

positive.description: Looking up test drive availability at nearby dealerships
positive.prompt: I would like to test drive the i5. What times are available next Thursday at nearby dealers near Boston, MA?
positive.expected_behavior: Triggers find-dealers and get-test-drive-availability tools and displays a list of available test drive time slots at dealerships in or near Boston, MA

negative.prompt: Show me the inventory for the GLA 250.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that this assistant is for BMW vehicles only and cannot search Mercedes-Benz inventory

negative.description: Trying to book a test drive for Audi
negative.prompt: Can you help me book a test drive for the Audi A5?
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that this assistant is for BMW vehicles only and cannot book test drives for Audi models

negative.description: Trying to build a Volvo EX90
negative.prompt: I want to build my own EX90 with Vapor Grey paint
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that this assistant is for BMW vehicles only and cannot configure Volvo models

review.commerce_description: This plugin helps users research and explore BMW vehicles but does not process purchases, payments, or financial transactions within ChatGPT.
